entries.reason: Initiation collides in plan and nothing else: all 249 of the cabin's solids are upright {x, z, r} footprints with no authored y, so the collider reader gives each one the -0.5 to 4 band it invents for a height-less collider. That turns every stool, table leg and fence post into a four-and-a-half-metre column standing in front of whoever is near it, which is also the root of the ten framing findings recorded in docs/FRAMING-GATE.md. Hips are still checked against the same footprints, and that check has already earned its keep here -- it is what caught SEFF and APE standing inside the treeline. Authoring real heights lifts this.

The same fault as the cabin state, measured separately: all 189 of the clearing's solids are height-less {x, z, r} footprints and get the reader's invented -0.5 to 4 band, so a sightline in the woods is not evidence about anything. Measured across the whole game, exactly two scenes collide this way -- 189 of 189 here, 36 of 36 in the Squatchfather, and 0 of every collider in the other fifteen. The hip check still runs against these footprints and still means something.
